title: Fixed-60Hz Framework tick driver: decouple session/input sampling from render framerate
description: Filed from TASK-054's AC3 audit (dev-t101, item 1 — GDD Annex D.1 'Adaptador HID → InputSnapshot' row requires '60 Hz fijo, desacoplado del render'; §3.2). FINDING: nothing in the Framework enforces a fixed tick. ArcadeInputBridge.Update() samples input per rendered frame; MicrogameLoopController.Update() advances the game via Time.deltaTime (variable timestep). The fixed-60Hz tick model exists only as Core-side config (SessionStateMachineConfig.TicksPerSecond) with no Framework driver honoring it. This breaks the GDD's determinism story at the Framework boundary: replay (.bcrp, T-115/TASK-032) and any tick-pinned behavior assume a fixed cadence that render framerate currently dictates. WORK: implement a fixed-60Hz driver (accumulator over Time.deltaTime with fixed-step consumption, or FixedUpdate with fixedDeltaTime aligned to 1/TicksPerSecond — design call) that samples InputSnapshots and advances SessionStateMachine.Tick at exactly 60 Hz regardless of framerate, replacing MicrogameLoopController's variable-timestep loop; handle spiral-of-death clamping ([ASSUMED]-tag the max-catch-up choice); keep render-side interpolation concerns out of scope unless trivially adjacent (GDD 10.4 interp factor is StagePresenter territory, TASK-027). VERIFICATION: Core tick logic is already fast-tested; the driver itself is Framework → PlayMode tests + Unity gate (same compile caveat as TASK-054).
acceptance_criteria: A Framework driver advances SessionStateMachine (and input sampling feeding it) at a fixed 60 Hz derived from SessionStateMachineConfig.TicksPerSecond, decoupled from render framerate (variable-frame Update no longer drives ticks directly).
Catch-up behavior under frame hitches is bounded and documented ([ASSUMED]-tagged max ticks per frame); no spiral of death.
PlayMode tests pin: N render frames at varying deltaTime produce the tick count wall-clock implies (within the clamp), and input sampled between ticks lands in the correct tick's snapshot.
Fast suite untouched; PlayMode leg + compile verification ride the Unity gate window.
